profile: TI CC26x2 SDK 2.30.00.34 persistence source review; no admitted backup/restore backend

review.write_value: one sequence octet plus sixteen random test octets; never a stored key fixture or qualified restore image
review.key_access: Legacy NV reads use MT_CheckNvId under build flags. In MT_SysNvRead, the assigned access-check error is overwritten by the later unconditional nvFps.readItem call; source review alone does not prove installed read denial.
review.persistence: ZDApp_SaveNwkKey writes active key/counter and network security material separately. ZDApp_NVUpdate may defer saving. The shown save/restore routines do not check each NV operation result. No atomic export/import transaction is established.
review.counter_restore: ZDApp_RestoreNwkSecMaterial adds MAX_NWK_FRAMECOUNTER_CHANGES plus NWK_FRAMECOUNTER_CHANGES_RESTORE_DELTA to a uint32 counter. Header defaults are 1000 and 250, both build-overridable. A restart increment cannot establish freshness of a stale backup or exclusion of another live coordinator.
review.layout: SSP structs retain active sequence/key/counter, but C sizeof/offsets and complete NV inventory depend on the exact installed build. No packed-image layout is adopted.
review.decision: Raw NV, reset, extended-address mutation and private credential reads remain outside ordinary host command admission. Restore is unsupported until an exact backend procedure establishes coherent private state, counter high-water continuity, durable custody, old-coordinator isolation and independent qualification.
review.evidence: Source/digest review and scripted host refusal only; no stale-backup validator, export/import implementation, installed firmware test or physical continuity evidence.
